title: Feature: mdview polish, accessibility, "open from anywhere", and delightful reader features

open_questions.question: N1: App name (8 options in plan 3.4)?
open_questions.default: MdV on the home screen, 'MdV: Markdown Viewer' in the App Store; fallbacks Mdown, then Markd.

open_questions.question: N2: Icon direction A (folded page + Markdown mark), B (MdV monogram) or C (reading lines)?
open_questions.default: A: name-independent and readable at 40 px.

open_questions.question: N4: Accept public.text as an Alternate document type (RTF/HTML shown as raw text)?
N5: Keep the extension's 'What was shared' panel in Release?
open_questions.default: Yes: read-only, stores nothing, helps support.

open_questions.question: N6: Schedule on-device AI (Summarize, Ask) with Foundation Models as v0.3 after 0.2.0?
open_questions.default: Yes, 2 beads, on-device model only, hidden on unsupported devices.

decided.question: D1: Network use for links (mdview://open?url=)?
decided.decision: No network. Universal Links with the content in the fragment, if links are wanted later.

decided.question: D2: Should Grok Bot send .md file attachments?
decided.decision: Yes, on the bot side (outside this repo), as well as the Share extension.

decided.question: D3: Share-sheet extension in the launch build?
decided.decision: Yes, superseded by the addendum: the Share extension is must-ship (M5).

decided.question: D7: Save to Files for pasted text?
D8: Drop the iPad drag-and-drop claim if it fails?
D10: If behind schedule on Nov 5?
decided.decision: Submit with M1-M10 plus L9; unfinished L beads ship in 0.1.1.

decided.question: D11: Extension hand-off to the main app?
decided.decision: Inline render only for launch; App Group 'Keep in MdV' later.

deferred.item: On-device AI (Foundation Models): Summarize and Ask about this file
deferred.note: Plan 3.9 sketch; iOS 26+, Apple Intelligence devices, SystemLanguageModel.default only, never server or PCC models; beads A1 (M) and A2 (L).
iOS 27 ignores third-party Markdown preview extensions.

deferred.item: 'Keep in MdV' from the Share extension (App Group)
Relative links, vault browsing, cross-file search, Spotlight, App Intents, widget, Handoff
deferred.note: Each needs folder access, a recents store or an App Group.

deferred.when: never, unless a native offline renderer exists
deferred.note: Needs a WebView, which lint forbids.

beads.title: Make opening fast: background parse, caches, lazy sections
beads.description: Must-ship before App Review (P0). See plan.md section 5, bead M8. Today Textual parses on the main actor and lays out every block eagerly, and ReaderView re-runs TextSearch on every access. Add DocumentPreparer: a detached task runs the pipeline, SectionSplitter (cuts at top-level ATX headings outside fences, only above 64 KB) and the parse with Textual's own parser options. StructuredText gets a PreparsedParser that returns the cached result. RenderedView shows a plain-text placeholder, then a LazyVStack of sections. Find matches move into @State with a 150 ms debounce. Files over 2 MB open in Source with `reader.renderAnyway`. The extension uses the same preparer.
acceptance: `swift test --package-path Packages/MDCore` passes SectionSplitter tests (one section below 64 KB, fences not cut, setext not cut, exact rejoin, CRLF)
RenderedView renders through StructuredText(_:parser:) with PreparsedParser, and no parse happens on the main actor
ReaderView stores find matches in @State, recomputed only on a debounced query or text change
App/mdviewUITests/LargeFileTests.swift covers a 300 KB sectioned file and a 2.5 MB file opening in Source with reader.renderAnyway
docs/perf/README.md records before and after medians from the MDCore performance tests
`make test` and `make lint` exit 0
